name: Où est Liberty?
source:
"Où est Liberty?" (Where's Liberty?) is a game set in the American countryside of the 60s and 70s.  You'll be taken on a psychedelic journey as Sunset, a young hippie searching for her dog, Liberty. 

You'll have to make some unusual encounters to find her.

[translated from [url=https://keurmythe.itch.io/ou-est-liberty]itch.io[/url]]
